title: 第19章 血债血偿第20章 赠你日日噩梦
slug: 恶毒师妹失忆后师兄们悔疯了
content_zh:
***
苏虞还不知道自己的东西被沈落雪截胡了，不过可能知道了也不在意。
她刚回到院子里，怀里的蛋蛋就像察觉到了什么奇怪的气息，变得格外警惕。
滑溜溜的鳞片蹭着她的掌心，似乎带着一丝不易察觉的颤栗。
“嘶嘶——主人小心！”
这是苏虞第一次听到它如此有攻击性的叫声。
她的心猛地一沉，反手将蛋蛋护进怀里，指尖飞快地在身前结印。
这套印诀无需耗费太多灵力，却能将周遭百丈之内的活物尽数排查，爹还打趣说，这个可以跟扫描仪媲美了。
嗯……虽然“扫描仪”具体是何物，她到现在都没搞懂。
然而下一秒，苏虞愣住了。
她万万没想到，原本空荡荡的识海，会突然出现无数个小白点，多得晃眼。
“？”
爹说过，有一个小白点，就代表有一个活物，这么多个点，难道是蛋蛋捅了蚂蚁窝吗？
苏虞的眉头皱得更紧，正想问它发现了什么。
这时。
似乎是她停下来太久了，原本藏在暗处的人突然出声。
“真不愧你能察觉到，看来就算成了瞎子，也没完全变成废人嘛。”
来人缓步走进月光里，绛紫色的裙摆扫过满地落叶，银质蛇铃叮当作响。
声音慵懒，却带着一丝杀意。
苏虞摸了摸蛋蛋的头以作安抚，心里却满是疑惑。

阿姮怎么会突然找上门？
难道她们之前也认识？
识海的小白点还在闪烁，苏虞这才后知后觉地反应过来——那些根本就不可能是蚂蚁。
是蛊。
密密麻麻的，全是蛊虫。
苏虞的后背瞬间沁出了一层冷汗，却还是很快冷静下来，试探道：“圣女不请自来是何意？我可没有得罪过你吧？”
她现在什么都不知道，这对她很不利。
阿姮像是看穿了她的心思，缓步逼近，“得罪？你当然没有得罪我……”
她的声音陡然冷了下来，带着彻骨的恨意。
“可你害死了我阿姊，凭什么现在还能活得好好的？！我要让你血债血偿！！”
“你阿姊？”
苏虞的心猛地一颤，被遗忘的画面忽然争先恐后地涌出来——
似乎有过一个穿着鹅黄衣裙的小女孩，在魔修要伤害她时，勇敢地挡在她身前。
可后来……
后来发生了什么？
记忆像是被蒙上了一层厚厚的雾，怎么也看不清。
阿姮见她这副模样，恨意更浓，抬手便要朝着苏虞抓去。
“我妹妹为了救你，身体被魔修活活撕碎！你倒好，不仅在这凌云宗安然享乐，还忘得一干二净！”
饶是苏虞看不见，也下意识后退躲避，却还是慢了半分，被她的指甲划破了脖颈。
剧痛瞬间顺着伤口蔓延开来，苏虞伸手捂住伤口，脸色瞬间惨白如纸。
content_en:
***
Su Yu didn't know that her belongings had been cut off by Shen Luoxue, but she might know and not care.
As soon as she returned to the yard, the balls in her arms seemed to sense some strange aura and became extra vigilant.
The slippery scales rubbed against her palm, seeming to shudder unnoticeably.
“Hiss—Master, be careful!”
This was the first time Su Yu heard such an aggressive cry.
Her heart suddenly sank, she held her balls in her arms with her backhand, and her fingertips quickly formed seals in front of her.
This set of seals does not require much spiritual energy, but it can detect all living creatures within a hundred feet of the surrounding area. Dad even joked that this is comparable to a scanner.
Hmm... although she still doesn't understand what a "scanner" is exactly.
However, the next second, Su Yu was stunned.
She never expected that countless small white dots would suddenly appear in the empty sea of ​​​​consciousness, so numerous that it was dazzling.
"?"
Dad said that if there is a small white dot, it means there is a living creature. With so many dots, could it be that Dandan stabbed the ant nest?
Su Yu's brows furrowed even more tightly, and he was about to ask what it had found.
At this time.
It seemed that she had stopped for too long, and the person who had been hiding in the dark suddenly spoke up.
"As expected of you, it seems that even if you become blind, you are not completely disabled."
The visitor walked slowly into the moonlight, the purple skirt swept the fallen leaves on the ground, and the silver snake bell jingled.
The voice was lazy, but with a hint of murderous intent.
Su Yu touched Dandan's head to comfort her, but her heart was full of doubts.
Why did Ah Heng suddenly come to the door?
Did they know each other before?
The small white dots in the sea of ​​​​consciousness were still flickering, and Su Yu realized belatedly - there was no way those were ants.
It's Gu.
Densely packed, all filled with Gu insects.
A layer of cold sweat broke out on Su Yu's back for a moment, but he quickly calmed down and asked tentatively: "What do you mean by the saint's uninvited visit? I have not offended you, have I?"
She doesn't know anything right now, and that's not good for her.
Ah Heng seemed to have read through her thoughts and slowly approached, "Offended? Of course you didn't offend me..."
Her voice suddenly turned cold, filled with utter hatred.
"But you killed my sister, why can you still live well now?! I want you to pay with your blood!!"
"Your sister?"
Su Yu's heart trembled suddenly, and forgotten scenes suddenly rushed out -
It seems that there was a little girl in a goose-yellow dress who bravely stood in front of the demon cultivator when he wanted to hurt her.
But later...
What happened next?
The memory seems to be covered with a thick layer of fog, and I can't see clearly.
When Ah Heng saw her like this, his hatred became even stronger, and he raised his hand to grab Su Yu.
"In order to save you, my sister's body was torn apart by demonic cultivators! It's a good thing for you, not only can you enjoy yourself peacefully in Lingyun Sect, but you can also forget all about it!"
Even though Su Yu couldn't see it, he subconsciously retreated to avoid it, but he was still half a minute too late and his neck was scratched by her nails.
Severe pain instantly spread along the wound. Su Yu reached out to cover the wound, and his face turned pale as a sheet.
